rv.q: Being a comedy sketch stretched out to feature length, An Act of God inevitably has its longueurs.
I'd rather go straight to hell than sit through 'An Act of God' again.

"It’s a One-Act of God to be precise, 90 minutes of presentational comedy that, if not quite divine, is at least good for a chuckle or two on our way to the ultimate curtain call...The writing begins to gel in the final half hour as a subtle seriousness sneaks in and mixes with a wry silliness.
Even at just 90 minutes, “An Act of God” (directed by the prolific Joe Mantello) is long-winded and full of unoriginal jabs at easy targets, but it is cute and occasionally witty.
Overall the play is laugh out loud funny; Parsons is brilliant in his role
